asutantweaks.feature.last_use_cancel.des: Keep the last item of a stack
asutantweaks.feature.last_use_cancel.det:
When only one item is left in your main hand, right-clicking a block with it is cancelled, so the stack is never used up.
Items that do not stack and creative mode are left alone.
Blocks in Last Use Blacklist (chests and shulker boxes by default) can still be right-clicked.
asutantweaks.feature.item_restock.desc: Refill the item in your hand from the inventory
asutantweaks.feature.item_restock.detail:
When you right-click a block and the stack in your main hand has fewer items than Restock Count, the same item is moved in from your inventory.
With Last Use Cancel on, one item is left behind in the inventory.
Tweakeroo has a similar feature.
asutantweaks.feature.auto_fill_inventory: Top up your stacks from an open container

While a container is open, items are taken from it until each stack in your inventory is full. The progress meter shows how far it has got.
Together with Last Use Cancel and Item Restock, you can refill without changing where items sit in your inventory.
asutantweaks.feature.disable_void_dive.d: Fly back up when falling into the void

When you fall below the void height of the current dimension, your elytra is opened and fireworks are used to fly you back up.
The height is set per dimension.
With Void Disconnect on, the game disconnects when fireworks or an elytra are missing. Reconnecting does not save you.
asutantweaks.feature.schematic_restricti: Choose which block states schematic restriction compares

When TweakerMore's schematic block placement restriction checks facing, the block states in Restriction Whitelist are compared with the schematic as well, and a mismatch stops the placement.
Where the mismatch is reported is set with Restriction Whitelist Message.
asutantweaks.feature.simple_item_entity_: Draw crowded item entities as one

When many item entities are packed together, only one of them is drawn, which raises the frame rate.
It also stops dropped items from bobbing up and down.
asutantweaks.feature.simple_mob_entity_r: When many mobs are packed together, only one of them is drawn, which raises the frame rate.
asutantweaks.feature.simple_entity_rende: Show how many entities were merged

Shows how many entities the two Simple Render features merged into one, next to the group.
The counts are cleared with the Clear Item Count hotkey.
asutantweaks.feature.enderchest_material: Count ender chest contents in Litematica's material list

Adds the contents of your ender chest, including what is inside shulker boxes there, to Litematica's material list. The contents are recorded when you close an ender chest.
EC Materiallist Filter limits which shulker box colours are counted.
In multiplayer, enable TweakerMore's serverDataSyncer and Carpet's debugNbtQueryNoPermission. If the first try fails, open the ender chest again.
asutantweaks.feature.search_block_highli: Highlight placed blocks from the item list

Highlights blocks placed in the world that are in Highlight Item List, within Highlight Block Range of you.
The Add Highlight Item hotkey adds the item in your main hand to the list.
asutantweaks.feature.search_container_hi:
Highlights containers within Highlight Container Range that hold an item from Highlight Item List. Containers are checked once a second.
In multiplayer the contents are fetched through TweakerMore's server data syncer.
asutantweaks.feature.placement_update_vi: Show which blocks a placement updates (red)
While you hold a block item, the blocks that would receive a block update from placing it are highlighted in red.
asutantweaks.feature.breaking_update_vie: While you hold a mining tool, the blocks that would receive a block update from breaking the block you look at are highlighted in blue.
asutantweaks.feature.update_view_instant: Limits the two update viewers to instant updates. Blocks updated on a scheduled tick, such as pistons and observers, are left out.
asutantweaks.feature.update_suppression_: Warn when an update chain can suppress updates
Shows "CCE suppress Ready" on the HUD when the update chain contains a position that could cause update suppression.
asutantweaks.feature.third_eye.desc: Show the world from a second camera in its own window
asutantweaks.feature.third_eye.detail:
Opens a separate window that draws the world from a second, free camera.
The camera starts at your eye position when the feature is turned on.
Fly the Third Eye camera with the keyboard

While on, WASD moves the Third Eye camera instead of you, Space raises it, Shift lowers it and Ctrl speeds it up.
The speed follows Tweakeroo's fly speed presets.
asutantweaks.feature.visualise_lazy_enti: Keep entities in lazy chunks at their real position

Items, falling blocks and primed TNT in chunks the server is not simulating are drawn still at their real server position, instead of falling or vanishing on the client. Mobs are not affected.
In singleplayer the state is read from the integrated server. In multiplayer, enable TweakerMore's serverDataSyncer and Carpet's debugNbtQueryNoPermission.
asutantweaks.feature.pick_block_ultimate:
Removes the reach limit from middle-click pick block, up to Pick Block Reach.
Hold the Pick Block State key while picking to copy the block state too, such as a composter's level or a repeater's delay. This needs creative mode.
Entities, and vanilla's Ctrl+pick within normal reach, are left to vanilla.
asutantweaks.feature.worldedit_gui.desc: Draw the WorldEdit selection as a grid
asutantweaks.feature.worldedit_gui.detai:
Draws the current WorldEdit cuboid selection as a grid on its six faces. Pos1 and Pos2 are outlined in their own colours as soon as each is set.
The selection comes over WorldEdit's CUI channel, so WorldEdit is needed in singleplayer or on the server. Other selection shapes are not drawn.
Record the WorldEdit selection on a transparent background

Records only the blocks in the WorldEdit selection as a video with a transparent background, while the world keeps running.
The Clear Block Render Screen hotkey opens its settings and a live preview. Clear Block Render Rec starts and stops recording.
ffmpeg is required. Videos are saved in clear_block_render/ in the game directory.
asutantweaks.feature.comparator_signal_v: Show each comparator's output on its top face

Shows the output signal strength of comparators within Comparator Signal Range on their top face.
Black values come from the server. Blue values are estimated on the client, and "?" means the comparator is lit but the estimate is 0.
asutantweaks.option.restock_count.detail: Item Restock refills when the stack in your main hand has fewer items than this.
asutantweaks.option.void_height_ow.detai: Disable Void Dive flies you back up when you fall below this Y in the Overworld.
asutantweaks.option.void_height_ne.detai: Disable Void Dive flies you back up when you fall below this Y in the Nether.
asutantweaks.option.void_height_end.deta: Disable Void Dive flies you back up when you fall below this Y in the End.
asutantweaks.option.void_disconnect.deta: Disconnects when Disable Void Dive cannot fly you back because fireworks or an elytra are missing. Reconnecting does not save you.
asutantweaks.option.restriction_state_wh: Block states that Restriction State Whitelist compares with the schematic.
asutantweaks.option.restriction_whitelis: Where a placement stopped by Restriction State Whitelist is reported.
asutantweaks.option.last_use_cancel_blac: Blocks you can still right-click with your last item while Last Use Cancel is on.
asutantweaks.option.enderchest_materiall: With the filter set to Whitelist, only shulker boxes of these colours are counted. Uncoloured shulker boxes are always counted.
With the filter set to Blacklist, shulker boxes of these colours are not counted.
Which colour list Ender Chest Material List applies to shulker boxes. None counts all of them.
Items that Search Block Highlight and Search Container Highlight look for.
asutantweaks.option.highlight_block_colo: Colour of the highlight drawn by Search Block Highlight.
asutantweaks.option.highlight_block_rang: How far from you, in blocks, Search Block Highlight looks.
asutantweaks.option.highlight_container_: Colour of the highlight drawn by Search Container Highlight.
How far from you, in blocks, Search Container Highlight looks.
asutantweaks.option.hud_log_timeout.deta: How long a message stays in the HUD log.
asutantweaks.option.hud_log_align.detail: Text alignment of the HUD log. The position is anchored on the same side.
asutantweaks.option.hud_log_position.det: Press the button, then click on the screen where the HUD log should go.
asutantweaks.option.progress_meter_posit: Press the button, then click on the screen where the Auto Fill Inventory progress meter should go.
asutantweaks.option.lazy_entity_sync_int: Ticks between two reads of the server position for Visualise Lazy Entity.
asutantweaks.option.pick_block_reach.det: Longest distance, in blocks, Pick Block Ultimate picks from.
asutantweaks.option.worldedit_grid_color: Colour of the grid lines on the WorldEdit selection.
asutantweaks.option.worldedit_edge_color: Colour of the selection's outer edges.
asutantweaks.option.worldedit_grid_max_l: Upper limit on grid lines. For a very large selection the spacing is doubled until the lines fit.
asutantweaks.option.comparator_signal_ra: How far from you, in blocks, comparator values are shown.
asutantweaks.option.comparator_signal_sy: Ticks between two server queries for the same comparator. Only used in multiplayer.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_width.detail: Width of the recording in pixels, independent of the game window.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_height.detail: Height of the recording in pixels, independent of the game window.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_speed.detail: 1.0 plays in real time, 0.5 at half speed, 2.0 at double speed. Frames are still captured at FPS, so a slow clip looks choppy unless FPS is raised.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_projection.detai: Isometric draws without perspective. Perspective uses FOV.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_fov.detail: Field of view for the perspective projection.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_zoom.detail: Zoom of the shot. The mouse wheel over the preview changes it too.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_yaw.detail: Horizontal camera angle. Dragging the preview changes it too.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_pitch.detail: Vertical camera angle. Dragging the preview changes it too.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_pan_x.detail: Sideways camera shift in blocks. Right-dragging the preview changes it too.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_pan_y.detail: Vertical camera shift in blocks. Right-dragging the preview changes it too.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_orbit_speed.deta: Turns the camera around the selection at this many degrees per second while recording.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_block_entities.d: Draw chests, signs and other block entities.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_players.detail: Draw players inside the selection. Off by default, since the player recording is usually standing in the shot.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_format.detail: WebM (VP9) plays in browsers. MOV (ProRes 4444) is for video editors. Both keep transparency.
asutantweaks.option.cbr_ffmpeg_path.deta: Path to ffmpeg, if it is not on PATH.
asutantweaks.hotkey.clear_item_count.det: Clears the counts shown by Simple Entity Render Count.
asutantweaks.hotkey.add_highlight_item.d: Adds the item in your main hand to Highlight Item List.
asutantweaks.hotkey.pick_block_ultimate_: Hold while middle-clicking to copy the block state with Pick Block Ultimate. It defaults to Left Alt so that vanilla's Ctrl+pick keeps working.
asutantweaks.hotkey.clear_block_render_t: Opens the Clear Block Render settings and preview.
asutantweaks.hotkey.clear_block_render_r: Starts or stops recording without opening a screen.
